visual.general_description: A proposed physiological mechanism diagram without case-specific measurements.
visual.detailed_description: An unlettered mechanism flow diagram on white. Blue ATOPY at far left points right into an outlined Disruption of skin barrier rectangle; a second outlined Disruption of GI barrier rectangle is immediately to its right. Their connector points down into a blue shaded box containing ↑ Water loss (inc. TEWL) and ↑ Na+ and protein loss, joined by two opposed arrows. Solid black arrows run from water loss down through ↓ ECV, ↑ Aldosterone, ↑ Na+ reabsorption in proximal tubules, and ↓ Na+ in distal tubule for exchange with K+, then right to ↓ K+ excretion and upward to the outlined HYPERKALAEMIA box. Sodium/protein loss points down to HYPONATRAEMIA; that box also points left toward proximal-tubule sodium reabsorption. Gray dashed branches run from skin-barrier disruption across the top to Cell lysis, Extracellular K+ release, and HYPERKALAEMIA; from GI-barrier disruption to Malabsorption, diet restrictions, Poor growth, ↓ Insulin levels, ↓ Intracellular K+ shift, and HYPERKALAEMIA. A dashed malabsorption branch also reaches HYPONATRAEMIA. Different colors/line styles separate the solid central-left and dashed right-hand routes. No patient photograph, anatomy acquisition, chart axes or numerical measurements appear.
